queries.name: Patient Latest Vitals (Indexed Search)
queries.sql:
SELECT reading_id, patient_id, metric_code, measured_at, value
FROM vitals_readings
WHERE patient_id = 'P101' AND metric_code = 'heart_rate'
ORDER BY measured_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
queries.execution_plan: SEARCH vitals_readings USING INDEX idx_vitals_patient_metric_time (patient_id=? AND metric_code=?)

queries.name: Unindexed Field Scan & Sorting (Full Table Scan)
queries.sql:
SELECT reading_id, patient_id, measured_at, value
FROM vitals_readings
WHERE raw_unit = 'bpm' AND quality_status = 'valid'
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 50;
queries.execution_plan: SCAN vitals_readings | USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

queries.name: Patient Time-Range Bounded Query (Indexed Range)
queries.sql:
SELECT reading_id, patient_id, metric_code, value, unit, measured_at
FROM vitals_readings
WHERE patient_id = 'P101'
  AND measured_at >= '2026-10-14 00:00:00'
  AND measured_at <= '2026-10-15 00:00:00'
ORDER BY measured_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
queries.execution_plan: SEARCH vitals_readings USING INDEX idx_vitals_patient_measured (patient_id=? AND measured_at>? AND measured_at<?)

queries.name: Clinical Alert Retrieval by Patient & Status
queries.sql:
SELECT alert_id, patient_id, rule_id, severity, category, status, created_at
FROM alerts
WHERE patient_id = 'P101' AND status IN ('NEW', 'ACTIVE')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 25;
queries.execution_plan: SEARCH alerts USING INDEX idx_alerts_patient_status_time (patient_id=? AND status=?) | USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

queries.name: Multi-Table Relational Join (Alerts + Patients + Doctor Assignments)
queries.sql:
SELECT a.alert_id, a.patient_id, p.first_name, p.last_name,
       dp.first_name AS doctor_first_name, dp.last_name AS doctor_last_name,
       a.severity, a.status, a.created_at
FROM alerts a
INNER JOIN patient_profiles p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
LEFT JOIN doctor_patient_assignments dpa ON p.patient_id = dpa.patient_id AND dpa.is_active = 1
LEFT JOIN doctor_profiles dp ON dpa.doctor_id = dp.doctor_id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
LIMIT 25;
queries.execution_plan: SCAN a USING INDEX idx_alerts_patient_status_time | SEARCH p USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_patient_profiles_1 (patient_id=?) | SEARCH dpa USING INDEX idx_assignments_patient (patient_id=?) LEFT-JOIN | SEARCH dp USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_doctor_profiles_1 (doctor_id=?) LEFT-JOIN | USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

queries.name: Statistical Aggregation with GROUP BY and HAVING
queries.sql:
SELECT patient_id,
       COUNT(*) AS reading_count,
       ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS mean_hr,
       ROUND(MIN(value), 2) AS min_hr,
       ROUND(MAX(value), 2) AS max_hr
FROM vitals_readings
WHERE metric_code = 'heart_rate'
GROUP BY patient_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY mean_hr DESC;
queries.execution_plan: SCAN vitals_readings USING INDEX idx_vitals_patient_metric_time | USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

queries.name: Time-Window Hourly Bucketing
queries.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', measured_at) AS hour_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS count_in_bucket,
       ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS avg_value
FROM vitals_readings
WHERE patient_id = 'P101' AND metric_code = 'heart_rate'
GROUP BY hour_bucket
ORDER BY hour_bucket DESC
LIMIT 24;
queries.execution_plan: SEARCH vitals_readings USING INDEX idx_vitals_patient_metric_time (patient_id=? AND metric_code=?) | USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
